subject: pe
title: Stretch: Advantages, Drawbacks & Tech
welcome_lead: Evaluate training methods — which one wins, and when?
meta_desc: GCSE PE Methods stretch: comparing methods, advantages, drawbacks, tech.
final_note: Top class! You can evaluate any training method on the spot.

concepts.def: Without oxygen — for short, intense bursts.
Mixing methods/sports to reduce injury and tedium.
Wearable tech recording distance, speed, HR.
Gradually increasing training load over time.

walkthroughs.body_html: Continuous — cheap, simple, low-injury but slow, can be boring. HIIT — time-efficient, big aerobic + anaerobic gains, fat loss, but high effort and injury risk. Choose based on athlete and goal.
Cross training combines methods — a runner adding cycling and swimming reduces impact while keeping aerobic gains. Helps avoid overuse injury and adds variety, beating tedium.

GPS watches, HR monitors and apps let athletes track sessions accurately. Data shows progression, identifies overtraining and motivates. Drawbacks include cost, distraction and over-reliance on numbers.
